people may told to be and act a certain way but at the end is your decision to do so or not.

those kids have been thought all those values during their childhood and some of them still grow up to be such jerks because they decided to ignore those values that

Another example will be of someone that was raises surrounded by a very christian
family decides to change religion and to be a Buddhist monk rater then a priest, altought his or her family work hard and always surrounded their child christian influences he or she
that morals of Buddhism are better then those of Christianity.
